architecture: shore power -> existing or dedicated marine low-voltage enclosure -> ESP32-S3 Wi-Fi logger -> electrically isolated DO and conductivity interfaces + RTD temperature -> local flash/SD buffer -> authenticated canonical Jubilee ingest endpoint

preferred_bom.item: Atlas Bare-Bones Wi-Fi Hydroponics Kit BB-Wi-Fi-HK
preferred_bom.role: ESP32-S3, enclosure, three electrically isolated EZO slots, USB-C power

preferred_bom.item: Atlas Lab Grade Dissolved Oxygen Probe ENV-40-DOX
Atlas EZO Dissolved Oxygen Circuit EZO-DO
Atlas Mini Conductivity Probe K1.0 ENV-20-EC-K1.0
preferred_bom.role: conductivity input used to derive salinity

preferred_bom.item: Atlas EZO RTD Temperature Circuit EZO-RTD
Atlas Standard PT-1000 Temperature Probe PT-ST
Atlas Zero Dissolved Oxygen Calibration Set
preferred_bom.role: zero-DO calibration because sub-1 mg/L accuracy is important

preferred_bom.item: Atlas Dissolved Oxygen Anti-Fouling Probe Screen

remaining_budget_for: marine cable glands and strain relief

sensor_strategy.dissolved_oxygen: Atlas galvanic DO/EZO-class candidate; zero-oxygen plus air-saturation calibration required because <1 mg/L performance matters
sensor_strategy.salinity: conductivity/EZO-class with electrical isolation from DO
sensor_strategy.depth: defer pressure/depth in phase 1 if necessary to stay below budget; pair fixed indexed sensor elevation with trusted water-level source

telemetry.wifi: existing pier network; owner accepts securely stored credentials; provision locally and never commit credentials to repository

mounting: retrievable stand-off/cage attached to pier-end piling, sensing faces offset into ambient flow, approximately 0.15-0.30 m above sediment; fixed stop/index for repeatable geometry after 7-14 day service; avoid piling stagnant microenvironment and prop wash
budget_rule: Verify delivered price and interface compatibility immediately before purchase. Prefer individual EZO circuits/probes plus one three-slot isolated Wi-Fi carrier to avoid duplicate carrier boards. Do not exceed $1,000 all-in.
model_rule: DIRECT only for the 437/Montrose sensor location; service/calibration/geometry changes are explicit metadata; production weight remains zero until QC and held-out incremental value are demonstrated.
